statusSemantics.pass: Score is at least 90 and no hard-veto findings exist.
statusSemantics.warn: Score is at least 80 and below 90 with no hard-veto findings.
statusSemantics.fail: Score is below 80 or at least one hard-veto finding exists.

confidence.reason: Required generated evidence is present, parseable, and within the freshness window.

dimensions.title: Gate Integrity
dimensions.description: Full gates remain available, fast paths are additive, and deep-test explains which full gates remain required.

dimensions.title: Evidence Completeness
dimensions.description: Machine-readable Workbench, deep-test, quality, decision, and trend evidence exist.

dimensions.title: Coverage Breadth
dimensions.description: Agent Dev has scenario, unit, E2E, contract, i18n, and host-api boundary coverage.

dimensions.title: Performance Discipline
dimensions.description: Latest timing evidence stays within budgets and refuses to treat over-limit runs as passing design evidence.

findings.message: Latest deep-test decision is blocked: typecheck exceeded hard performance limits.
findings.recommendation: Treat this as an audit failure until limit steps are optimized or the budget is intentionally revised with evidence.
Use pnpm run typecheck:cached for repeated daily loops, and keep pnpm run typecheck as the uncached release gate.
Use pnpm agent-dev:deep-test:reuse for the smoke daily loop, and pnpm agent-dev:deep-test:reuse:full only when full Agent Dev E2E evidence is needed without rebuilding.
Keep node-environment Agent Dev tests split from the jsdom host facade test so full unit coverage stays parallel where it is safe.
Keep the shared scenario baseline separate from task-specific changed-path ownership checks.
Keep contract scanning text-based and bounded to host-api/service sources.

dimensions.title: Docs And Runbook
dimensions.description: Developer docs explain daily loops, full gates, release evidence, and failure interpretation.

dimensions.title: Maintainability
dimensions.description: The system avoids parallel registries, has focused unit protection, and keeps generated evidence bounded.
